# Security

Please don't open a public issue. Use
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/mindsersit/homebrew-tap/security/advisories/new)
or write to **hello@mindsers.it**, for this repository and for `tom` alike: its source isn't public.

## What's in scope here

A release here is what people install, so these matter most:

- an archive, a checksum or a signature that doesn't verify against the key in the README;
- a formula or `tom/VERSION` that points somewhere it shouldn't.
